spans.s: इय tad affix ( घन् ) in the sense of 'pity'; e. g. देवियः, यज्ञियः; cf.
इया case-ending for inst. sing. in Vedic Literature; e. g. उर्विया, दार्विया; cf.
ईय substitute for the tad.afix छ; e.g: शालीयः, मालीयः etc; cf

इयङ् substitute for the last इ before a vowel generally in the case of monosyllabic roots end- ing in इ and the word स्त्री; e.g. चिक्षियुः, नियौ नियः, स्त्रियौ स्त्रियः; cf. अचि क्षुधातुभ्रुवां य्वोरियङुवङौ
ईयङ् ' afix ईय added to the root ऋत्, ङ् showing the application of the Ātmanepada affixes; e. g. ऋतीयते cf.

ईयस् tad-affix ईयसुन् , showing superi- ority or excellence of one indivi- dual over another in respect of a quality, added to a substantive ex- presive of quality; when the subst- antive ends in the affix तृ, that affix तृ is removed: e.g. पटीयान्, लघीयान्, गरीयान्, दोहीयसी (धेनुः) cf.
ईयसुन् the same as ईयस् which see above.
